workflows.scenario: Start a Bank Simulator session, verify the account dashboard is usable, and review the checking account's read-only activity ledger

steps.action: Open the Bank Simulator welcome page
steps.expected: The welcome page loads and offers a GET STARTED NOW button to begin a session
The app navigates to the account dashboard and shows a one-time welcome dialog
The welcome dialog closes, revealing the account dashboard
The dashboard shows a Checking Account Activity widget and a Saving Account Activity widget, each with a visible available balance

steps.action: Open the checking account's activity from the dashboard
steps.expected: The Account Activity page opens for the checking account and lists its transaction ledger

steps.action: Confirm the checking ledger reflects the dashboard's available balance
steps.expected: The ledger's most recent transaction row shows a Balance cell matching the available balance shown on the dashboard

workflows.test: generated_tests/www.ngpf.org/playwright_tests/tests/account-activity.spec.ts#starts a simulator session and reviews checking account activity
